name: dimensionchain-simple
description: IXT-SUITES simple rung for `dimensionChain` (pro tier): the 2D plan editor's 'Chain dims' button, gated by the `dimensionChain` flag, in the Plan menu (fileActions fragment). Simple: Plan menu has no 'Chain dims' entry at all. Pro: click 'Chain dims' generates a real row of consecutive dimension strings along the default flat's bottom + left baselines (`addChainDimensions`) — asserted via the store's `floorPlan.dimensions` array, then undone, then re-verified hidden back in Simple.

steps.name: boot-splash-gone
steps.failMessage: #boot-loader still covering the screen. It is removed from the DOM only once `booting` clears, which depends on sceneReady — measured 751ms and 36604ms across two runs of the SAME scenario, so no fixed wait covers it. Every screenshot before this point is the loader, and nothing fails (v0.31.9.6).

steps.name: assert-flag-off-simple
steps.eval: (function(){ const f = window.__store.getState().featureFlags.dimensionChain; if (f !== false) throw new Error('dimensionChain should resolve false in Simple mode, got ' + f); })()

steps.name: open-plan-menu-simple
steps.eval: (async () => { const find = () => [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find((x) => x.textContent.trim() === 'Plan ▾'); const deadline = Date.now() + 5000; while (Date.now() < deadline) { if (document.querySelector('.plan-menu-panel')) return; const b = find(); if (b) b.click(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 200)); } throw new Error('Plan menu did not open'); })()

steps.name: assert-hidden-in-simple
steps.eval: (function(){ const panel = document.querySelector('.plan-menu-panel'); if (!panel) throw new Error('Plan menu panel missing'); if ((panel.textContent||'').includes('Chain dims')) throw new Error("'Chain dims' visible in Simple mode — dimensionChain is pro-tier and should be hidden"); })()

steps.name: close-plan-menu
steps.eval: (async () => { const find = () => [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find((x) => x.textContent.trim() === 'Plan ▾'); const deadline = Date.now() + 3000; while (Date.now() < deadline) { if (!document.querySelector('.plan-menu-panel')) return; const b = find(); if (b) b.click(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 200)); } throw new Error('Plan menu did not close'); })()

steps.name: assert-flag-on-pro
steps.eval: (function(){ const f = window.__store.getState().featureFlags.dimensionChain; if (f !== true) throw new Error('dimensionChain should resolve true in Pro mode, got ' + f); })()

steps.name: open-plan-menu-pro
steps.eval: (async () => { const find = () => [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find((x) => x.textContent.trim() === 'Plan ▾'); const deadline = Date.now() + 5000; while (Date.now() < deadline) { const panel = document.querySelector('.plan-menu-panel'); if (panel && (panel.textContent||'').includes('Chain dims')) return; const b = find(); if (b && !panel) b.click(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 200)); } throw new Error('Plan menu (Pro) did not show Chain dims'); })()

steps.name: click-chain-dims
steps.eval: (function(){ const panel = document.querySelector('.plan-menu-panel'); const btn = panel && [...panel.querySelectorAll('button')].find((b) => b.textContent.trim() === 'Chain dims'); if (!btn) throw new Error("'Chain dims' button not found in Pro menu"); btn.click(); })()

steps.name: close-plan-menu-2
steps.eval: (async () => { const find = () => [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find((x) => x.textContent.trim() === 'Plan ▾'); const deadline = Date.now() + 3000; while (Date.now() < deadline) { if (!document.querySelector('.plan-menu-panel')) return; const b = find(); if (b) b.click(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 200)); } throw new Error('Plan menu did not close'); })()

steps.name: assert-flag-off-again
steps.eval: (function(){ const f = window.__store.getState().featureFlags.dimensionChain; if (f !== false) throw new Error('dimensionChain should resolve false back in Simple mode, got ' + f); })()

steps.name: open-plan-menu-simple-2
steps.eval: (async () => { const find = () => [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find((x) => x.textContent.trim() === 'Plan ▾'); const deadline = Date.now() + 5000; while (Date.now() < deadline) { if (document.querySelector('.plan-menu-panel')) return; const b = find(); if (b) b.click(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 200)); } throw new Error('Plan menu did not open'); })()

steps.name: assert-hidden-again
steps.eval: (function(){ const panel = document.querySelector('.plan-menu-panel'); if (!panel) throw new Error('Plan menu panel missing'); if ((panel.textContent||'').includes('Chain dims')) throw new Error("'Chain dims' visible back in Simple mode"); })()
